text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I was talking with Admire Groove
about nutritional balance in meals.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll make up for what's lacking with supplements.
All that's left that I need is... chocolate...
choice_data_list: Chocolate definitely is great for a quick sugar boost.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I never said anything about chocolate.
As if I would want to eat such a thing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove has lost her focus. Perhaps fatigue from the races is catching up to her... I may need to reconsider her race schedule.
